description: Extend Tailwind config with complete design token system: boxShadow (xs, sm with tinted primary shadows, md, lg, xl), zIndex layers (base 0, sticky 10, floating 20, header 30, overlay 40, modal 50, toast 60), animation keyframes (bounceIn, pulseSlow, shake, successCheck, flipRtl) and animations (bounce-in, pulse-slow, shake, success-check, flip-rtl), borderRadius enhancements (xs 2px, sm 4px). This locks in the visual design language for all subsequent components.
steps: Extend theme.extend.boxShadow in Frontend/tailwind.config.js with 5 shadow layers (xs: primary-950 tinted, sm: primary-950 tinted, md: standard, lg: standard, xl: standard)
Add theme.extend.zIndex with 7 layers: base (0), sticky (10), floating (20), header (30), overlay (40), modal (50), toast (60)
Add theme.extend.keyframes with 5 new animations: bounceIn (fade + bounce), pulseSlow (slow pulse), shake (horizontal shake), successCheck (checkmark draw), flipRtl (180deg flip with RTL direction)
Add theme.extend.animation with 5 new animation classes corresponding to keyframes: bounce-in, pulse-slow, shake, success-check, flip-rtl
Verify borderRadius extends with xs (2px) and confirm sm (4px) already exists in Tailwind defaults
acceptance_criteria: All 5 boxShadow variants compile and are usable via @apply shadow-xs, shadow-sm, etc.
All 7 zIndex layers are accessible via z-base, z-sticky, z-floating, z-header, z-overlay, z-modal, z-toast
All 5 animation keyframes and animations are defined and testable via @apply animate-bounce-in, etc.
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
No console errors or warnings during npm run build
verification: npm run typecheck — should pass with no errors
npm run build — should complete successfully
Inspect compiled CSS: verify shadow, z-index, animation classes are present
findings: All steps implemented successfully. Extended boxShadow with 5 variants (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) using primary-950 tinted colors for xs and sm. Added zIndex 7-layer system (base 0 through toast 60). Implemented 5 new keyframes (bounceIn, pulseSlow, shake, successCheck, flipRtl) with corresponding animation classes. Verified borderRadius—Tailwind defaults already provide sm (4px); added xs (2px) to custom config for completeness. npm run typecheck passed with zero errors. npm run build completed successfully with no warnings related to design tokens.
